# Kymera Group

> Kymera Group (Zanè, Vicenza, Italy) supplies new, used and reconditioned tannery machines, spare parts and consumables to tanneries in 70+ countries. Family in the leather trade for three generations, over 20 years in tannery machinery. Member of Assomac.

Contact: info@kymeragroup.it · WhatsApp +39 320 573 1618 · Via G. Leopardi 51/52, 36010 Zanè (VI), Italy

Key facts:
- Machines are sold used (as-is), reconditioned (load-tested, worn parts replaced, 6-month warranty) or fully rebuilt (stripped to the frame, new electrical panel, full warranty).
- Spare parts and consumables for all major Italian tannery machine brands: felts, splitting and shaving blades, band knives, toggle clips, buffing paper.
- KEP (Kymera Easy Pay): rotating credit line for tanneries — deferred payment, no paperwork, no bank guarantees, no minimum orders.
- Kymera also buys used tannery machines and complete lines.
